rss: Burnham to unveil public body to invest in electricity grid
title: Solar Energy Gets a Boost
story: The town wants to use more solar energy. This can help make power cheaper and better for Earth.
storyBig: The local council plans to invest in solar energy to reduce electricity costs and enhance sustainability. This decision could lead to lower energy prices and support the environment.
think: How can using solar power help the planet?
bull: Solar energy can make electricity cheaper!
bear: Switching to solar energy takes time and planning.

title: Content Creation: Cool New Career
story: Some kids are learning how to make videos and posts for jobs. It's a new way to earn money.
storyBig: Degrees in content creation are becoming popular, enabling individuals to make money through social media platforms. This reflects a trend towards digital careers in today's economy.
think: What skills are important for making videos and posts?
bull: You can make fun videos and maybe even a job out of it!
bear: Not everyone might find success in this new career path.
